stemMarkdown: Find the sum to infinity of the geometric progression $12, \dfrac{12}{4}, \dfrac{12}{16}, \ldots$ (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The common ratio is $\dfrac{1}{4}$, whose absolute value is below 1, so the series converges. Sum $= \dfrac{a}{1 - r} = \dfrac{12}{1 - 1/4} = 16.0$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The formula only applies when the ratio is strictly between -1 and 1; otherwise the terms never die away.
